metadata.description: Deterministic validity checks (evidence receipts, experiment audit, reproduction verdicts) for Claude Code

plugins.name: consilience-audit
plugins.description: Deterministic, receipt-backed audit of agent-run experiments (AutoDiscovery runs, CodeScientist experiment directories): are the reported numbers in the output, is the n right, is there a real test, effect size, baseline and multiplicity control. Runs beside AutoDiscovery's Validity Check; never calls a model.

plugins.name: consilience-receipts
plugins.description: Deterministic evidence receipts for Asta workspaces: unknown .ev keys, missing quotes, citations missing from references.bib, orphaned entries, provenance format, quotes verbatim in local source text (with SHA-256 and offsets), number overreach and certainty upgrades. No model calls.

plugins.name: consilience-reproduce
plugins.description: Reproduction verdicts read from the numbers: the asta-flows secondary-reproduction rubric (faithfulness, decidability, outcome) as deterministic checks, plus commit-order and verbatim-hypothesis checks, with receipts
